summary: Document PLATE default Copilot review effort Lite at repo/org level and Balanced for risk:high or risk:critical review requests; record that default effort is not API-readable so no doctor check (#1095).
migration_impact: Adopters should read docs/copilot-review.md and set repository Copilot code review Review effort level to Lite in GitHub Settings; use Balanced only when requesting review on high-risk PRs.
migration_guidance: 1. Open repository Settings → Copilot → Code review and set Review effort level to Lite (organization default optional).
2. When requesting Copilot review on PRs labeled risk:high or risk:critical, choose Balanced for that request only.
3. No gh plate import-payload or workflow change is required; verify manually because GitHub does not expose the default effort level via REST/GraphQL read APIs.
agent_notes: Default effort is UI-only on GitHub; PLATE does not add doctor/adopt verification until a read API exists. Pair with agents/github-actions-and-copilot.md for when to request Copilot at all.
